tagline: An investment record you can trace.
loginHint: Use the owner account initialized on your host.
expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
failed: The request failed. Check the details and try again.
name: Name
sourceHint: Order dates are not wallet confirmations. Missing files do not mean no new activity.
frozen: A saved observation, not a live quote.
noReportHint: Upload a supported CSV or enter a dated BTC total. Preview it before confirming.
noPortfolios: Create a private portfolio to begin.
nativeHint: Original-currency securities exclude the CAD-valued BTC proxy. Bitcoin is shown separately.
growthHint: Value changes include deposits, withdrawals and market moves. They are not investment returns.
onePoint: One observation so far. More dated snapshots will build this history.
companyHint: Weight uses the whole portfolio, including cash. Unresolved ETF constituents remain unclassified.
noExposure: No resolved company exposure in this observation. See the downloaded report for unresolved holdings.
noBtc: No Bitcoin observation in this report.
btcHint: BTC and LBTC are tracked as BTC equivalent. Funding and purchase spend must not be counted twice as contributions.
noFlows: No cash flows recorded. This does not establish zero contributions.
uploadHint: Use either supported CSV, both, or an optional dated BTC total. Nothing is imported until you confirm a ready preview.
openingHint: First Bull import needs an explicit opening declaration. Use the documented JSON schema.
confirmHint: This commits the confirmed inputs and generates reports. Existing history is retained.
noJobs: No jobs yet. Start with a preview.
previewHint: Preview is offline. Official references and report validation may still be pending until formal execution.
workerHint: Queued work waits for the instance worker. You can leave this page.
policyHint: The proxy estimates unknown acquisition costs; it does not establish actual historical costs.
saved: Settings saved. Existing reports are unchanged.
passwordHint: Changing the password ends all sessions.
maintenance: Advanced BTC events, contributions and legacy adoption remain available through the CLI; Web forms are planned.
error.stale_preview: Inputs changed. Create a new preview.
error.stale_engine: The application changed. Create a new preview.
error.preview_unavailable: Preview is blocked or expired. Create a new one.
error.portfolio_busy: Resolve the existing update before starting another.
error.invalid_upload: Check the file format, encoding and limits.
error.body_too_large: The file is too large. Check the documented limits.
error.upload_integrity: Stored evidence changed. Upload the correct file and preview again.
error.report_integrity: Report integrity needs local review. Do not reimport to guess the result.
error.invalid_request: Check the required fields and timestamp offsets.
error.authentication_required: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.logout_failed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Retry sign-out before leaving a shared device.
status.opening_plus_orders_unadjusted_fo: Opening plus purchases; wallet fees not supplied
exportScope: Exports use this saved report. Missing values stay unknown; this is not a full backup. Date limits are inclusive; BTC monthly limits include whole months.
error.maintenance: Maintenance is in progress. Retry shortly.
error.export_too_large: The export exceeds its limit or the bundle is incomplete. Download individual files or review on the host.
error.invalid_export_range: Check the date range and choose a dated dataset.
recordsHint: Save dated evidence, review discrepancies, and retain every revision. Saving data leaves published reports unchanged.
recordTask: What would you like to record?
recordRevision: Correct, void or link a BTC record
openingReferenceAt: Total observation time with UTC offset
openingBasis: Why this difference is pre-tracking holdings
linkedBalance: Balance to explain (optional for new events)
purchasedQuantity: Recorded acquisition quantity at reference time
recordSavedHint: Data saved. Review current records, then prepare a new report to include these changes.
recordConfirmHint: Save this reviewed declaration to the selected ledger. Previous revisions and published reports remain available. No prices or reports are generated by this step.
noRecords: No records yet. Add evidence above when available.
recordsTruncated: This page shows up to 1,000 records per category. The complete history remains in your ledger and backups.
renderSaved: Prepare a report from saved data (no new CSV required)
balanceDeclarationHint: Use the total BTC + LBTC equivalent across all tracked wallets. Enter a timestamp with UTC offset. A difference remains unexplained until you provide dated evidence; it is never automatically classified as a fee or contribution.
openingDeclarationHint: Requires imported acquisition records. Freezes total minus known net purchases and applicable events as pre-tracking BTC quantity, with unknown actual cost. New balance observations do not recalculate it.
flowDeclarationHint: Record actual cash movements, not holdings growth or purchase spend. USD requires dated FX evidence or an explicit sourced CAD value. Transfers need a shared pairing reference. CSV columns: date, account_id, flow_type, currency, amount; optional flow_id, transfer_id, usd_cad, amount_cad, fx_date, fx_source.
coverageDeclarationHint: Declare complete only after checking all external brokerage flows in (start, end]. This does not establish Bull funding origins or combined-portfolio return eligibility. Later declarations are retained.
revisionDeclarationHint: Select an active record and action. Corrections require the displayed revision and a reason. Identity changes require voiding and an explicit replacement; link events to the balance interval they explain.
error.request_rejected: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
error.preview_failed: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
error.commit_state_requires_review: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
status.ledger_conflict: Opening or source overlap needs review
migrationVerification: Verified at migration. Original publication checksums were unavailable; historical authenticity is not established.
knownEventsAtReference: Known net events at reference time (BTC)
observedSubtotalHint: These values cover valued observed holdings, not complete wealth. Missing contributions and full portfolio returns remain unknown.
sourceApprovalHint: Review each source account and destination. Confirmation binds these mappings, observed totals and explicit valuation references.
sourceMappingRequired: Account choices are incomplete. Submit a new source preview with reviewed bindings before confirming.
parserModeHint: Automatically detect enabled formats. Review account mappings before committing. No CSV means saved facts only; purchase history does not prove wallet balances.
fetchPublicReferences: Fetch public dated FX/BTC references before approval
referencesRequired: References are missing. Supply JSON or explicitly allow public reference retrieval.
